'''Randloi''' was a business in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] at the time of the conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was located at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]], next to a pawn shop known as [[Cvoy Pawn/Legends|Cvoi Pawn]]. A bright [[Color/Legends|yellow]] sign with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters was used to attract customers.<ref name="To Catch a Jedi" />
